evidence.quote: we started working with a new account spending $30 a day, and I'm going to show you our exact creative test. In here, you can see that we launched 13 ads. They're spending $30 a day, so we don't have really that much budget here. I initially set our impression limit to 1,000, just so we can get done with this test pretty quickly. But, I noticed that our CPMs were on average like 50, 60, 70 dollars. And so, that means, and I I saw the comments from the other video, you know, $17 CPA is really unrealistic. This is a little bit more realistic with a newer account with a pixel that doesn't have much data to lower our CPM. And so, with that, we had to lower our impression limit to 800 just to make sure that we finish this test efficiently without blowing through a ton of budget.
